overrides.value: Puts the ChatGPT or DeepSeek web chat in Zotero's right sidebar. It sends selected PDF or EPUB text, or a whole PDF, to the open chat, and the item menu can ask for a summary or reading questions.
overrides.reason: Translated from the feature list of README.md, which is in Chinese. The upstream has no English description: the manifest and the GitHub About text are in Chinese.
